title: Productising an internal reconciliation tool
thesis: The reconciliation tool we built for ourselves solves a problem other firms describe.
note: Internal leverage is the whole point; external evidence is thin but real.

evidence.title: Finance lead describes the same reconciliation problem
evidence.body: We reconcile three systems by hand every month. It takes two days and it is always wrong somewhere.

evidence.title: A vendor charges heavily for the equivalent
evidence.body: The established tool starts at four figures a month, which is why smaller firms do it by hand.

evidence.title: Our own tool already does this
evidence.body: We built reconciliation for our own books eighteen months ago and it has run since without changes.
